column3: The Hebrew describes meeting him and placing the crown with uncompleted verbs; BSB uses past actions.
The Hebrew makes him blessings forever; BSB says You grant him blessings.
The Hebrew repeats find; BSB uses apprehend and seize.
The Hebrew makes them like a furnace; BSB places them in a furnace. The Hebrew names the time of Your face.
The Hebrew names their fruit and seed; BSB says descendants and offspring.
The Hebrew describes their plotting as completed actions; BSB uses present verbs.
The Hebrew names a shoulder, bowstrings in the plural, and their faces; BSB says put to flight and trains a bow upon them.
